info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Location Data Retrieval API
info.description: The Location Data Retrieval API provides access to crucial market data related to geographical locations. This API allows users to retrieve detailed information on specific location datasets, enabling businesses to analyze and leverage location-based insights. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and data analysts seeking to enhance their market research. By utilizing this endpoint, users can efficiently obtain key location metrics and trends to inform strategic decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve location data management for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed location data management information for a specified resource identified by RES-100045. It provides essential insights for managing and analyzing market data effectively.
